title: STARWARS_DELTA Cutscene Script V1
description: Backward-compatible semantic cutscene authoring format. ChatGPT authors story, narrative identity, visible evidence, frame-relative composition, semantic actor motion, performance, continuity, closed-world Cutscene projectile selection and legal audio handles. General cast identities use authoritative CURRENT Actor handles. Dialogue participants are the deliberate exception: they use only curated identityHandle values published by EMOTIONAL_DIALOGUE_CURRENT.json. Unity owns CURRENT fingerprints, runtime IDs, exact V3/V5 materialization, camera bounds, launcher/muzzle mechanics, supported runtime motion lowering and final serialization. Semantic motion names do not imply stronger target-relative runtime behavior than the current V5 Timeline supports.

id.description: Narrative identity key. For any cast entry used by dialogue, this value MUST exactly equal that curated Emotional Dialogue character's published actorId. No alias or display-name matching.

identityHandle.description: Authoritative CURRENT narrative identity handle. For normal/non-dialogue cast this must be a legal Actor handle. For cast used as dialogue speaker/listener this must be the exact logical identityHandle published for the same actorId in EMOTIONAL_DIALOGUE_CURRENT.json; it is not required to be an Actor Catalog handle and must never be replaced by a portrait/UI handle.

presentationHandle.description: Optional CURRENT presentation handle for portrait/body/world evidence. It never creates or changes narrative identity. Dialogue identity remains owned by EMOTIONAL_DIALOGUE_CURRENT.json.

evidence.description: Required plain-language audience-observable proof for this beat. It must state what will actually be visible/audible that proves the beat's story claim or dramatic function; it is not backend bookkeeping.

handle.description: Exact legal CURRENT authoring handle. Pixel inspection must determine whether the visual is a reusable single actor or an already-grouped/fleet visual before using count expansion.

count.description: Requested visible instance count. Intended for reusable single-instance visuals or another route explicitly supporting expansion. Do not multiply a precomposed group/fleet visual as though it were one actor.

startOffsetSeconds.description: Effect-only local offset from the start of the owning beat. Defaults to 0. The Effect must start before the beat ends.

durationSeconds.description: Effect-only active duration inside the owning beat. If omitted, the Effect remains active from startOffsetSeconds through the end of the beat.

performanceIntent.description: Semantic performance intent such as urgent_locomotion, fear, command, injured, relief, resolve, look_up, point or help. Unity resolves legal execution.

animationIntent.description: Semantic animation family intent such as walk, run, interact or hit. Never author raw animation IDs here.

effectHandle.description: Exact Effect handle for effect/impact authoring where applicable. Never use effectHandle to carry Cutscene projectile identity.

projectileId.description: Exact closed-world Cutscene projectile identity. Required for type=fire Simple V1 actions that lower to VisualWeaponAction. Unsupported explicit IDs block with CUTSCENE_PROJECTILE_NOT_AUTHORING_READY. No gameplay, filename, effectHandle or fuzzy fallback.

count.description: For type=fire, maps directly to the VisualWeaponAction / launcher burst count. Unity preserves/clamps the authored burst count to the supported range 1..64.

motionIntent.description: Semantic motion request lowered by Unity into existing V5 actorActions. motionIntent=orbit maps to real V5 Actor Orbit. Current Actor Orbit v1 uses a fixed/stationary center and cannot overlap movement of its target/center actor. Pursuit/Escort/Intercept names do not by themselves guarantee per-frame target-relative tracking.

speed.description: Semantic speed value. Unity maps this deterministically; it is not a numeric float literal and must not be parsed directly as one.

speaker.description: Exact actorId of an authoringReady Emotional Dialogue character and exact matching cast[].id. No aliases or display-name matching.

listener.description: Optional exact actorId of an authoringReady Emotional Dialogue character and exact matching cast[].id. No aliases or display-name matching.

expressionIntent.description: Exact published supported expression name for the speaker. If omitted Unity uses that character's published defaultExpression. Unsupported values are blockers; there is no Neutral fallback or filename search.

handle.description: Authoritative CURRENT Audio handle. Never infer from a filename or display name.

subject.description: Semantic composition subject. It is not automatically a physical Transform target. Hold and curated dialogue presentation may preserve this subject while backend physical target remains empty.

camera.description: Camera movement is semantic directing intent. camera.movement=orbit is a 2D/2.5D camera/parallax concept and is separate from actor motionIntent=orbit. It must never invent unsupported 3D geometry or viewpoints.
